panel.name: sim_panel
panel.text: These are the same overlays as Develop > Render Metadata, and toggling either place moves both. The dials below each overlay set what it draws; the wind flowmap also reads SSAtmoWindFlowDebugRange.

check_box.name: info_overlay_check
check_box.label: Show info overlay
check_box.tool_tip: On-screen readout of weather values, particle counts, impact rate and the indoor/outdoor probe result

check_box.name: flow_overlay_check
check_box.label: Draw the wind flowmap
check_box.tool_tip: Same overlay as Develop > Render Metadata > Wind flow

check_box.name: shadow_overlay_check
check_box.label: Draw the rain shadow map
check_box.tool_tip: Same overlay as Develop > Render Metadata > Rain shadow

check_box.name: settle_overlay_check
check_box.label: Mark geometry changes waiting to settle
check_box.tool_tip: A beacon over every prim change still waiting out its settle delay, green as it comes due and red once it has re-armed too often to ever settle. Same overlay as Develop > Render Metadata > Geometry settling

check_box.name: runoff_overlay_check
check_box.label: Draw the roof runoff
check_box.tool_tip: The eaves, the water they hold and what they shed, in the mode picked below. Same overlay as Develop > Render Metadata > Roof runoff

check_box.name: field_overlay_check
check_box.label: Draw the world field
check_box.tool_tip: The shared field's view, picked below. Same overlay as Develop > Render Metadata > World field

combo_box.name: C_field_view
combo_box.tool_tip: Band surfaces: every surface the capture resolved, hue by band so stacked storeys read separately. Air labels: the connectivity flood, outside-connected air green and fading with occlusion depth, sealed interior air red. Drainage: standing water blue and the D8 outlet chain of the filled surface

check_box.name: strike_marker_check
check_box.label: Mark pending lightning strikes
check_box.tool_tip: Sheet strikes get a ring where the flash will bloom, forks their future channel, ground strikes the channel plus a box at the attachment point, each with a floating countdown in a colour of its own - chosen to read against white storm cloud. Same switch as the Effects & LOD floater

check_box.name: footstep_marker_check
check_box.label: Mark footstep audio sources
check_box.tool_tip: A bright flash where a footstep sound starts playing, then a small dim dot riding the source until it stops - shows start moments, whether loops follow their avatar, and stop timing

text.name: T_flow_style
text.tool_tip: Arrows read one cell at a time; flow lines read where the air goes

text.name: T_flow_capture
text.tool_tip: Draw one capture pass in place of the flow field, as the world points that pass actually saw

combo_box.name: C_flow_capture
combo_box.tool_tip: Each pass is drawn where it saw geometry, so a direction that missed a whole swathe of the region shows as a hole rather than as nothing at all. Carve candidates: green opened by a probe, amber no probe could see it, dim red correctly blocked

text.name: T_runoff_view
text.tool_tip: What the roof runoff overlay draws, one stage of the shed per view

combo_box.name: C_runoff_view
combo_box.tool_tip: Eaves shows every edge that could shed; shed flow shows the water each holds; spawn gates colours each eave by why it is quiet; drips and streams draws what the shed actually spawned

text.name: T_shadow_view
text.tool_tip: What the rain shadow overlay draws

combo_box.name: C_shadow_view
combo_box.tool_tip: Texel cloud unprojects every captured depth texel to the world point it saw: olive on the ground, green through blue as a hit climbs clear of it, violet for tall structures, magenta where the fall only grazed a near-vertical face and the shelter answer there is a guess. Landing grid is the same capture resampled the way the surface field and the drainage trace read it, loud red on cells the capture never reached and that silently fall back to the bare heightmap. Depth map draws the capture itself in the corner of the screen, holes black, the only view that can be read against the resolution setting. Capture volume draws the ortho box, the band it spans and each tile's state, for regions that never got a usable map at all

text.name: T_shadow_stride
text.tool_tip: Draw every Nth depth texel; 1 is the map at full resolution and the heaviest to bake

slider_bar.name: SB_shadow_stride
slider_bar.tool_tip: Sample spacing of the texel cloud, in depth map texels. 1 draws every texel; higher thins it out. Below 1 the cloud interpolates between texels the way the map is read when sampled - smoother, not more detailed - and is doubled automatically if the map is too fine to bake that many points

spinner.name: S_shadow_stride
spinner.tool_tip: Sample spacing of the texel cloud, in depth map texels. 1 draws every texel; higher thins it out. Below 1 the cloud interpolates between texels the way the map is read when sampled - smoother, not more detailed - and is doubled automatically if the map is too fine to bake that many points

panel.text: Blowing snow lifted off the ground by the wind, and the local fog veil that comes with a whiteout. Both only run for snow types in freezing temperatures.

text.name: T_snow_lift
text.tool_tip: Draw the transport's per-cell lift figure over the ground - blue at onset, white mid-band, orange at saturation

combo_box.name: C_snow_lift
combo_box.tool_tip: Draw the transport's per-cell lift figure over the ground - blue at onset, white mid-band, orange at saturation

text.name: T_whiteout_view
text.tool_tip: What the whiteout veil draws in place of its fog

combo_box.name: C_whiteout_view
combo_box.tool_tip: Fog shows the veil as it renders; coverage shows its amount as grayscale; gate shows the outdoor-air test; split shows the density terms (red squall, green drift, blue height)

check_box.name: drift_debug_check
check_box.label: Force drift particles (oversized, magenta)
check_box.tool_tip: Spawns blowing snow regardless of weather and lifts, oversized and solid magenta - if you cannot see these streaming along the ground, the drift tier is not rendering

check_box.name: whiteout_enable_check
check_box.label: Render the whiteout veil
check_box.tool_tip: The local, height-limited fog layer. Off freezes the layer even mid-storm; it ramps back in when turned on

text.name: T_whiteout_strength
text.tool_tip: Master dial on the whiteout layer; 0 removes it entirely

slider_bar.name: SB_whiteout_strength
slider_bar.tool_tip: Master dial on the whiteout layer; 0 removes it entirely

spinner.name: S_whiteout_strength
spinner.tool_tip: Master dial on the whiteout layer; 0 removes it entirely

panel.text: A depth capture along the fall direction, per region, deciding what catches each drop.

text.name: T_shadow_res
text.tool_tip: Texels across a region; 1024 is about 0.25m accuracy on a 256m region

slider_bar.name: SB_shadow_res
slider_bar.tool_tip: Texels across a region; 1024 is about 0.25m accuracy on a 256m region

spinner.name: S_shadow_res
spinner.tool_tip: Texels across a region; 1024 is about 0.25m accuracy on a 256m region

text.name: T_shadow_age
text.tool_tip: Seconds between full recaptures; local prim updates also queue one

slider_bar.name: SB_shadow_age
slider_bar.tool_tip: Seconds between full recaptures; local prim updates also queue one

spinner.name: S_shadow_age
spinner.tool_tip: Seconds between full recaptures; local prim updates also queue one

button.name: shadow_rebuild_button
button.label: Recapture now
button.tool_tip: Drop every cached rain shadow map and capture them again

panel.text: Rain that lands on a roof runs to its edges and drips off the eaves into the street below. Only the roofs near the camera shed, and only while it is actually raining.

check_box.name: runoff_enable_check
check_box.label: Shed runoff off roof edges
check_box.tool_tip: Rain only; snow settles on a roof rather than running off it

text.name: T_runoff_scale
text.tool_tip: Multiplier on how much water the eaves shed; 0 stops shedding entirely

slider_bar.name: SB_runoff_scale
slider_bar.tool_tip: Multiplier on how much water the eaves shed; 0 stops shedding entirely

spinner.name: S_runoff_scale
spinner.tool_tip: Multiplier on how much water the eaves shed; 0 stops shedding entirely

text.name: T_runoff_radius
text.tool_tip: Metres from the camera within which roof edges shed drips

slider_bar.name: SB_runoff_radius
slider_bar.tool_tip: Metres from the camera within which roof edges shed drips

spinner.name: S_runoff_radius
spinner.tool_tip: Metres from the camera within which roof edges shed drips

panel.text: A static fluid solve per region, driving wind audio and precipitation drift. Solved once, then left alone until the build or the wind changes.

check_box.name: flow_enabled_check
check_box.label: Solve the wind flowmap
check_box.tool_tip: Off falls every consumer back to the single uniform wind vector

check_box.name: flow_advect_check
check_box.label: Let the flowmap carry precipitation
check_box.tool_tip: Drops curve around buildings and funnel down alleys instead of drifting uniformly

check_box.name: flow_particles_check
check_box.label: Let the flowmap carry in-world particles
check_box.tool_tip: Particle systems flagged to follow the wind feel the local field instead of the sim's uniform breeze

text.name: T_flow_cell
text.tool_tip: Metres per cell. 4m is about the width of an alley; smaller resolves narrower gaps and costs more

slider_bar.name: SB_flow_cell
slider_bar.tool_tip: Metres per cell. 4m is about the width of an alley; smaller resolves narrower gaps and costs more

spinner.name: S_flow_cell
spinner.tool_tip: Metres per cell. 4m is about the width of an alley; smaller resolves narrower gaps and costs more

text.name: T_flow_res
text.tool_tip: Ceiling on texels per axis. Only a wide varregion reaches it, and then cells get coarser than the target

slider_bar.name: SB_flow_res
slider_bar.tool_tip: Ceiling on texels per axis. Only a wide varregion reaches it, and then cells get coarser than the target

spinner.name: S_flow_res
spinner.tool_tip: Ceiling on texels per axis. Only a wide varregion reaches it, and then cells get coarser than the target

text.name: T_flow_margin
text.tool_tip: How far a region's solve looks into its neighbours. The overlap is what keeps wind continuous across a sim border

panel.text: How deep the surges run, how far apart their fronts are and how far the wind swings as one passes are per-track weather, on the main window. This is only how the waves travel.

text.name: T_gust_travel
text.tool_tip: How fast fronts sweep downwind relative to the air itself. 1 carries them along with it, so a surge reaches the far side of a region as late as the air takes to get there; 0 pins the pattern to the ground so the wind rises and falls in place instead of in waves
